title: "Within 24 hours...": Trump again claims he stopped India
description: The US President was referring to the border clashes between India and Pakistan that followed India's precision strikes in May this year on Pakistani terror camps under Operation Sindoor, launched in response to the Pahalgam terror attack in Jammu and Kashmir that killed 26 civilians.

title: Now, Trump claims ‘8 planes shot down’ in India
description: US President Donald Trump has this time claimed that “eight planes were shot down” during the India-Pakistan skirmish in May and that he personally intervened to broker peace between the two nuclear-armed neighbours by threatening to halt trade talks.

title: Cricket Fever: T20 World Cup Set for India-Sri Lanka Grand Stage
description: The BCCI has announced Ahmedabad, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, and Mumbai as venues for the T20 World Cup, with co-hosting duties by Sri Lanka for neutral Pakistan matches. The event's full schedule will be released soon, anticipating large audiences for matches in major Indian cities.

title: Amit Shah Praises PM Modi's Swift Action Against Pakistan-Sponsored Terrorism
description: Union Minister Amit Shah highlighted PM Narendra Modi's decisive response to terrorism with Operation Sindoor post-Pahalgam attack, contrasting it with inaction under Congress rule. Shah criticized Rahul Gandhi for divisive remarks on the Army and applauded Modi's crackdown on the Popular Front of India (PFI).

title: T20 World Cup 2026 finale at Narendra Modi Stadium? Check big update here
description: The ICC is set to host the 2026 T20 World Cup in India and Sri Lanka, with major Tier 1 Indian venues selected. Bengaluru's Chinnaswamy Stadium is excluded due to safety concerns following a stampede. Colombo will host a semi-final if Sri Lanka or Pakistan qualify, and remains a standby for the final if Pakistan reaches it.
